  "rationale": "All eight columns are genuine part-of aspects of 'patient_needs' rather than external predictors, causes, or restatements, so each qualifies as a constitutive facet. Exhaustiveness is high: the set covers purpose, clinical domain, acuity, continuity stage, intervention, referral, diagnostics, and prevention -- most main constitutive dimensions of what a patient needs (a psychosocial/education need facet is a modest gap). Mutual exclusivity is only moderate: several facets overlap conceptually. 'visit_purpose_category' (e.g., preventive_wellness, medication_management, post_procedure_followup) substantially re-encodes distinctions captured by 'preventive_or_screening_need', 'intervention_need_type', and 'care_continuity_stage'. Likewise 'intervention_need_type' and 'specialist_referral_need'/'diagnostic_workup_need' all describe the care-action dimension and partially co-vary. These overlaps mean the facets do not cleanly carve the concept into non-overlapping aspects, lowering the ME score."
